name: Agent plugins
auth: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.
fresh_home: Use a temporary JFrog CLI home and a separate AW_PLUGIN_HOME; run plugin operations with env HOME="$AW_PLUGIN_HOME" so no real Cursor or Claude installation is modified.
prerequisites: A plugin/ directory containing .cursor-plugin/plugin.json with name hello-plugin and version 1.0.0.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export JFROG_CLI_HOME_DIR="$AW_WORK/jfrog"
export JFROG_CLI_TEMP_DIR="$AW_WORK/tmp"
export JFROG_CLI_REPORT_USAGE=false
jf config add aw --url "$AW_URL" --artifactory-url "$AW_URL/artifactory" --access-token "$AW_TOKEN" --interactive=false
configure.note: Runtime-only configuration. Use a shell with tracing disabled; remove AW_WORK after use. No token is part of this recipe source.

steps.code: env HOME="$AW_PLUGIN_HOME" jf agent plugins publish plugin --repo "$AW_REPO" --version 1.0.0

install.note: The native CLI installs the Cursor plugin into the isolated home.

steps.code:
env HOME="$AW_PLUGIN_HOME" jf agent plugins install hello-plugin --harness cursor --repo "$AW_REPO" --version 1.0.0
env HOME="$AW_PLUGIN_HOME" jf agent plugins list --harness cursor --format json

limitations: Claude marketplace JSON and ZIP authorization are tested, but this recipe claims the actual Cursor adapter install performed by JFrog CLI, not a Claude desktop install.
Remote, virtual and federated classes are unsupported.
